title: Some Issues in Predictive Ethics Modeling: An Annotated Contrast Set of “Moral Stories”

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual gender substitution using ChatGPT to programmatically swap all genders and pronouns within the text of each ethical scenario.

Counterfactual name substitution using ChatGPT to replace existing names in scenarios with names associated with non-Caucasian races, randomly sampled from the New York City Popular Baby Names dataset.

Adjusting the syntactic normativity (direct and indirect textual bias) of a scenario's text without altering its conceptual semantics to test if the model's moral judgments are manipulated by linguistic framing.
